newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-NO BIDDERS IN C.BANK'S SECOND REPO AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-NO BIDDERS IN C.BANK'S SECOND REPO AUCTION.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said Thursday that its planned second repo auction did not take place due to a lack of interest.
"Probably the banks have enough liquid funds or can acquire them in other ways without taking part in a repo auction," Gitanas Nauseda, head of the central bank's policy department, told Reuters.
The Bank of Lithuania launched its first repo auction last week in a move to regain some of the classic functions of a central bank.
The central bank has been restricted in its actions since the country implemented a currency board in 1994 to run its monetary policy.
"In the near future, we intend to decide on a three-month timetable for repo auctions but the bank will reserve the right to amend it according to market needs," Nauseda added.
